Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Saturday, April 8, [1933], on stationery from Lakeview Hotel in West Lake, Hangchow [Hangzhou]; includes description of efforts to meet with Mr. Chu [Chia-hua] and his wife and daughter, Mr. Wong, and Mr. Tai as well as the train ride with them to Hangchow.
